video.title: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Video) (4K Remaster)

motivational.video_read: This is the music video for Rick Astley's 'Never Gonna Give You Up' — 214 seconds of song lyrics, transcribed by YouTube's automatic captions, with a comment section dominated by Rickroll meme culture. There is no spoken monologue, no speaker, no advice, and no moment anywhere in the transcript where a viewer's self-image is changed by what is said. The material I hunt for does not exist in this video.
